mapper.select: SELECT teacher_id, name, title, dance_type, experience_years, avatar_url, bio, created_at FROM sys_teacher ORDER BY created_at DESC, teacher_id DESC
SELECT teacher_id, name, title, dance_type, experience_years, avatar_url, bio, created_at FROM sys_teacher WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} LIMIT 1
SELECT teacher_id, name, title, dance_type, experience_years, avatar_url, bio, created_at FROM sys_teacher WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_teacher (teacher_id, name, title, dance_type, experience_years, avatar_url, bio) VALUES (#{teacherId}, #{name}, #{title}, #{danceType}, #{experienceYears}, #{avatarUrl}, #{bio})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_teacher SET name = #{name}, title = #{title}, dance_type = #{danceType}, experience_years = #{experienceYears}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, bio = #{bio} WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} OR name = #{name}
